verify_detail: tap showed the app had been replaced by the launcher/Device Care, corroborating the crash.\n\n**Root cause indication:** `ExportPolicy.export()` (ExportPolicy.kt:11) throws `IllegalStateException` because some internal "export buffer" isn\'t initialized for this item — worth checking whether Item 013 has a null/missing field (e.g., a lazy-initialized buffer that only gets set up for certain items, or an off-by-one on buffer allocation tied to list index) that the first 12 items don\'t trigger.'
